items.name: tokens
items.title: Cubby UI tokens
items.description: Design tokens of Cubby UI as two stylesheets: the custom properties themselves (dark canon plus a light theme) and the Tailwind v4 @theme inline mapping that turns them into utilities.
items.author: Sergey Orshak

items.name: cn
items.title: cn
items.description: Tailwind class merge tuned for Cubby UI's text styles: without it, tailwind-merge mistakes text-ui-md for a colour and silently drops the size next to text-text-1.
items.author: Sergey Orshak
items.docs: A separate lib/cn.ts, not an edit to lib/utils.ts: the standard cn from shadcn init stays in place, and Cubby UI components import @/lib/cn.

items.name: icon
items.title: Icon
items.description: A Hugeicons Stroke Rounded glyph, or any other SVG passed as children, in the four canonical sizes: 12 — checkbox tick, 16 — content, 20 — navigation, 32 — empty-state illustration. Always aria-hidden.
items.author: Sergey Orshak
items.docs: Requires Cubby UI tokens: npx shadcn@latest add kenetatuse80471-creator/cubby-ui/tokens — then import cubby-tokens.css and cubby-theme.css after @import "tailwindcss".

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A ring with a gap, 20 or 12, an 800ms linear spin; stops under prefers-reduced-motion.
items.author: Sergey Orshak
items.docs: Requires Cubby UI tokens: npx shadcn@latest add kenetatuse80471-creator/cubby-ui/tokens — then import cubby-tokens.css and cubby-theme.css after @import "tailwindcss".

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Button: primary | secondary | danger | text, height 32 or 28, icon slots on both sides, a loading state that swaps the icon for a spinner.
items.author: Sergey Orshak
items.docs: Requires Cubby UI tokens: npx shadcn@latest add kenetatuse80471-creator/cubby-ui/tokens — then import cubby-tokens.css and cubby-theme.css after @import "tailwindcss".

items.name: icon-button
items.title: IconButton

items.name: tag
items.title: Tag

items.author: Sergey Orshak

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A 20 / 24 / 28 / 32 / 64 circle with a photo or initials, a stage tone, and a real empty state for "nobody assigned".
items.author: Sergey Orshak
items.docs: Requires Cubby UI tokens: npx shadcn@latest add kenetatuse80471-creator/cubby-ui/tokens — then import cubby-tokens.css and cubby-theme.css after @import "tailwindcss".

items.name: empty-state
items.title: EmptyState
items.description: Empty state: a 32 icon, a title, an explanation and an action. Each container writes its own copy.
items.author: Sergey Orshak
items.docs: Requires Cubby UI tokens: npx shadcn@latest add kenetatuse80471-creator/cubby-ui/tokens — then import cubby-tokens.css and cubby-theme.css after @import "tailwindcss".

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A 30×18 toggle on Base UI: accessibility and keyboard behaviour come from the primitive, geometry and colour from the tokens.
items.author: Sergey Orshak
items.docs: Requires Cubby UI tokens: npx shadcn@latest add kenetatuse80471-creator/cubby-ui/tokens — then import cubby-tokens.css and cubby-theme.css after @import "tailwindcss".

items.name: modal
items.title: Modal
items.description: A blocking dialog on Base UI: scrim, header and footer cut off by dividers, the body as the only scrolling area, and five widths from 460 to 940.
items.author: Sergey Orshak
items.docs: Focus trap, Escape, a press on the scrim, focus return and the body scroll lock (scrollbar compensated) come from Base UI Dialog. `title` and `closeLabel` are required — the dialog is named by its title and the × by its label. Compose with `ModalTrigger` and `ModalClose`, or drive it with `open` / `onOpenChange`. Needs the Cubby UI tokens: npx shadcn@latest add kenetatuse80471-creator/cubby-ui/tokens — then import cubby-tokens.css and cubby-theme.css after @import "tailwindcss".

items.name: snackbar
items.title: Snackbar
items.description: One snackbar at a time on Base UI Toast: undo lives 5 seconds, a quiet confirmation 3, an error until it is dismissed by hand.
items.author: Sergey Orshak
items.docs: Wrap the app in `SnackbarProvider` and call `useSnackbar().notify({ kind, message, actionLabel, onAction, closeLabel })`. A new snackbar displaces the one on screen — the queue never piles up — and every timer pauses while the viewport is hovered or holds focus. `Snackbar` without a toast object renders the same bar statically. Needs the Cubby UI tokens: npx shadcn@latest add kenetatuse80471-creator/cubby-ui/tokens — then import cubby-tokens.css and cubby-theme.css after @import "tailwindcss".

items.name: context-action-menu
items.title: ContextActionMenu
items.description: The row-level «…» menu on Base UI Menu: 210 wide, items 28 high, the destructive ones last in their own group behind a divider.
items.author: Sergey Orshak
items.docs: Pass `actions` and the required `ariaLabel`; the default trigger is a text IconButton with «…». Opening by click, arrow keys, Enter, Escape, typeahead and the focus returning to the trigger are Base UI. The `Menu*` parts are exported as well, so the same surface can be composed into any popover. Needs the Cubby UI tokens: npx shadcn@latest add kenetatuse80471-creator/cubby-ui/tokens — then import cubby-tokens.css and cubby-theme.css after @import "tailwindcss".

items.name: text-input
items.title: TextInput
items.description: Single-line field on Base UI's Input: regular/large/form heights (32/40/36), default/raised tone, an optional leading icon and a clear button.
items.author: Sergey Orshak
items.docs: Requires the Cubby UI tokens: npx shadcn@latest add kenetatuse80471-creator/cubby-ui/tokens — then import cubby-tokens.css and cubby-theme.css after @import "tailwindcss".

items.name: text-area
items.title: TextArea
items.description: Multiline field that fits its height to its content between a 72px minimum and a 240px cap, then scrolls internally; default/raised tone.
items.author: Sergey Orshak
items.docs: Requires the Cubby UI tokens: npx shadcn@latest add kenetatuse80471-creator/cubby-ui/tokens — then import cubby-tokens.css and cubby-theme.css after @import "tailwindcss".

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Dropdown built on Base UI's Select (not the native element): regular/compact trigger, default/raised tone, keyboard and ARIA handled by the primitive, popup styled per the popover spec.
items.author: Sergey Orshak
items.docs: Requires the Cubby UI tokens: npx shadcn@latest add kenetatuse80471-creator/cubby-ui/tokens — then import cubby-tokens.css and cubby-theme.css after @import "tailwindcss".

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: A row of tabs on Base UI: roving-tabindex keyboard handling and ARIA from the primitive, the active tab a film/3 fill rather than a sliding underline, per the board spec.
items.author: Sergey Orshak
items.docs: `←→` move focus between tabs without selecting, `Enter`/`Space` select, `Home`/`End` jump to the ends — Base UI's own composite keyboard handling, not reimplemented here. `size` on `TabsTab` is `regular` (32) or `compact` (28, the board spec's own measurement — see the report for which one should default). `TabsIndicator` is exported for a sliding-underline look but unused by default: the spec's active state is a fill on the tab itself. Needs the Cubby UI tokens: npx shadcn@latest add kenetatuse80471-creator/cubby-ui/tokens — then import cubby-tokens.css and cubby-theme.css after @import "tailwindcss".

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A hover/focus hint on Base UI's Tooltip, fit-content up to 240, with the trigger-popup aria-describedby link the primitive itself leaves out wired in by hand.
items.author: Sergey Orshak
items.docs: Shows on hover and on keyboard focus only — not a mouse click that leaves the trigger focused, Base UI's own `:focus-visible` gate — hides on Escape; none of that is reimplemented here, only the `aria-describedby` Base UI's Tooltip leaves out (unlike its Dialog, Popover and Toast). `TooltipTrigger` renders a plain button by default; pass `render` to attach the tooltip to an existing element instead. Wrap a group of triggers in `TooltipProvider` to share one open delay, so adjacent tooltips in the same row open instantly once the first one is visible. Needs the Cubby UI tokens: npx shadcn@latest add kenetatuse80471-creator/cubby-ui/tokens — then import cubby-tokens.css and cubby-theme.css after @import "tailwindcss".
